```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(wordcloud)
library(readr)
SB57_merged_labeled <- read_csv("~/SDS264_F26/SB57_merged_labeled.csv")

# One word per row
SB57_tidy <- SB57_merged_labeled |>
  unnest_tokens(word, text, token = "words")

# No stop words
SB57_no_stop_words <- SB57_tidy |>
  anti_join(stop_words) 
  
# Names
SB57_names <- SB57_tidy |>
  filter(str_detect(word, "hurts|mahomes|kelce|reid|chiefs|eagles|andy|kc"))

# Only Eagle fans comments
SB57_eagles <- SB57_tidy |>
  filter(str_detect(flair, ":Eagles: Eagles" ))

# Only Chief fans comments
SB57_chiefs <- SB57_tidy |>
  filter(str_detect(flair, ":Chiefs: Chiefs"))
```

```{r}
# Most common words
SB57_no_stop_words |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Word Cloud
common_words <- SB57_no_stop_words |>
  filter(!str_detect(word, "[a-z]+’[a-z]+")) |>
  count(word) |>
  filter(word != "NA") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

wordcloud(
  words = common_words$word, 
  freq = common_words$n, 
  max.words = 50, 
  random.order = FALSE
)

common_words_no_names <- common_words |>
  anti_join(SB57_names) |>
  filter(!str_detect(word, "\\d"))

wordcloud(
  words = common_words_no_names$word,
  freq = common_words_no_names$n,
  max.words = 50,
  random.order = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Most negative and most positive words
bing_sentiments <- get_sentiments("bing")

get_sentiments("bing") |>
  filter(sentiment == "positive") |>
  inner_join(SB57_no_stop_words) |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE)

get_sentiments("bing") |> 
  filter(sentiment == "negative") |>
  inner_join(SB57_no_stop_words) |>
  anti_join(SB57_names) |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Plot of 10 most negative and 10 most positive words

SB57_no_stop_words |>
  inner_join(bing_sentiments) |>
  anti_join(SB57_names) |>
  filter(!str_detect(word, "super")) |>
  count(sentiment, word, sort = TRUE) |>
  group_by(sentiment) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(word, n), y = n, fill = sentiment)) +
    geom_col() +  
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ sentiment, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Count",
       y = "Word",
       fill = "Sentiment")
```

```{r}
# Bar plot of average comment length for chiefs and eagle fans

SB57_merged_labeled |>
  filter(str_detect(flair, "^:Eagles: Eagles$|^:Chiefs: Chiefs$")) |>
  mutate(length_comment = str_count(text, "\\b[^ ]+\\b")) |>
  group_by(flair) |>
  summarise(mean_length = mean(length_comment)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = flair, y = mean_length, fill = flair)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "Team",
         y = "Mean Comment Length",
         fill = "Team") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(":Chiefs: Chiefs" = "#E31837", ":Eagles: Eagles" = "#004C54"))
```
